description: Header file defining the MinidumpProcessor class for processing minidump crash reports, including methods for extracting system info, crash reasons, and handling minidump data.

classes.name: MinidumpProcessor
classes.description: Class responsible for processing minidump crash reports, extracting system info, crash details, and managing symbol resolution.

methods.name: Process
methods.description: Processes a minidump file or structure to fill in the process state with crash information.

methods.name: GetCPUInfo
methods.description: Extracts CPU architecture information from a minidump.

methods.name: GetOSInfo
methods.description: Extracts operating system information from a minidump.

methods.name: GetProcessCreateTime
methods.description: Retrieves the creation time of the crashed process from a minidump.

methods.name: GetCrashReason
methods.description: Provides a textual reason for the crash, including exception address if available.

methods.name: GetAssertion
methods.description: Retrieves assertion information from a minidump if present.

methods.name: set_enable_objdump
methods.description: Enables or disables objdump disassembly during processing.
